description: Implementation of the QueryVk class for Vulkan queries in ANGLE, handling query lifecycle, result retrieval, and transform feedback integration.

classes.name: QueryVk
classes.description: Class managing Vulkan query objects, including starting, ending, retrieving results, and handling transform feedback.

methods.name: QueryVk
methods.description: Constructor initializing the QueryVk object with a specific query type.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up query resources when the query object is destroyed.

methods.name: end
